name: lvid.dialog/meeting_decision/ami
source: AMI Meeting Corpus, decision annotations (Carletta et al., 2005)
criteria_source: Adapted from the AMI decision annotations
notes: 133 meetings, 500 decisions (250 made, 250 not, each asked as made or as not made); the full meeting audio and a close-up video are the input. 71 % of the meetings are from AMI's training split. Models that do not take audio (OneJev-27B) are unsupported.
